typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		MCID as string,
		LAST_NM as string,
		FIRST_NM as string,
		MIDDLE_INIT as string,
		BIRTH_DT as timestamp,
		GNDER_CD as string,
		ADDRESS_1 as string,
		ADDRESS_2 as string,
		CITY as string,
		STATE as string,
		ZIP_CD as string,
		COUNTRY as string,
		ADDRESS_TYPE as string,
		MEDCR_NBR as string,
		MDCD_NBR as string,
		PHONE_NBR as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT [MCID]       ,[LAST_NM]       ,[FIRST_NM]       ,[MIDDLE_INIT]       ,[BIRTH_DT]       ,[GNDER_CD]       ,[ADDRESS_1]       ,[ADDRESS_2]       ,[CITY]       ,[STATE]       ,[ZIP_CD]       ,[COUNTRY]       ,[ADDRESS_TYPE]       ,[MEDCR_NBR]       ,[MDCD_NBR]       ,[PHONE_NBR]   FROM [DATA_EXCHANGE].[EXTRACT].[REGISTRY_MEMBERS_ROSTER] RSTR   WHERE RSTR.MARKET = ?     1',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(MCID = MCID) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		ZIP_CD as string,
		BRTH_DT as string,
		ADDRESS_TYPE as string,
		MEDCR_NBR as string,
		STATE as string,
		FIRST_NM as string,
		GNDR_CD as string,
		CITY as string,
		COUNTRY as string,
		MCID as string,
		LAST_NM as string,
		MDCD_NBR as string,
		MIDDLE_INIT as string,
		PHONE_NBR as string,
		ADDRESS_1 as string,
		ADDRESS_2 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ZIP_CD,
		BRTH_DT = BIRTH_DT,
		ADDRESS_TYPE,
		MEDCR_NBR,
		STATE,
		FIRST_NM,
		GNDR_CD = GNDER_CD,
		CITY,
		COUNTRY,
		MCID,
		LAST_NM,
		MDCD_NBR,
		MIDDLE_INIT,
		PHONE_NBR,
		ADDRESS_1,
		ADDRESS_2)) ~> FlatFileDestination
